# Privacy Policy Content Checklist: Standalone pages for doncoleman.ca

**Purpose**: Validate that the privacy policy requirements make accurate, properly hedged claims about data handling.
**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `/speckit-checklist`. Items test the quality of the written requirements, not the implementation.

## Claim Accuracy

- [ ] CHK001 - Is each policy claim (no cookies, contact fields, Canadian storage, retention, statistics) traced to a source of truth (constitution, foundation, current cookie policy)? [Traceability, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is "the site sets no cookies" stated with scope covering analytics and the contact form's spam protection, or is any exception a gap? [Clarity, Spec §US6-1]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is the description of visitor statistics specific (Cloudflare Web Analytics, main build only, no cookies, no personal tracking) and consistent with the foundation? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is storage location stated consistently with Principle VII (Fly.io, Toronto, no processing outside Canada)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is it specified whether the spam-protection service's handling of visitor data is disclosed, given it is a third party? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]

## Draft Marking

- [ ] CHK006 - Are the contact field list and retention period required to be visibly marked as unconfirmed placeholders, distinct from the page-level draft notice? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the hand-off to the Contact feature defined (who confirms, where the placeholders are listed, how they are found)? [Gap, Spec §Follow-up work]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is it specified that the policy must not state a concrete retention duration until confirmed? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the draft flag for the privacy policy required to stay until the Contact feature confirms the claims? [Gap, Spec §FR-024]

## Completeness of Content

- [ ] CHK010 - Are user rights and a contact route for privacy questions addressed or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-022]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the "relevant content" absorbed from the cookie policy defined, and content that no longer applies (Ghost, members) identified for removal? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the policy's effective or last-updated date requirement stated? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 - Does the plain-language rule (no hype or filler) apply to legal text without making claims vaguer? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024]
